usage.outputShape: body.image_url (JPG URL); also body.width, body.height, body.file_size_bytes, body.content_type, body.frame_type, body.source_url
quirks: Registry lists method=GET but that only returns a self-describing manifest (name/price/input_schema/input_example). The real paid call is POST.
Pay with POST + JSON body {video_url, frame_type}; video_url is required, frame_type is optional enum first|middle|last (defaults appear to honor 'middle').
Output image is hosted at a fal.media URL (returned in body.image_url), not inline bytes — fetch the URL to get the JPG.
x402 payment $0.03 on Base via CDP facilitator.
usage.guide: Send POST to https://x402-deployer.x402-deployer.workers.dev/video-thumbnail with JSON body {"video_url":"<mp4 url>","frame_type":"first|middle|last"} (only video_url is required). The x402 payment is $0.03 USDC on Base. The response is JSON; read body.image_url for the extracted frame JPG (fal.media hosted), plus width/height/file_size_bytes metadata. A GET to the same URL returns only a price/schema manifest, not a result — always POST to actually run it.
